channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Aqalka Cad: Trump, Xi iyo Putin ayaa Khamiista Shenzhen ku yeelan doona kulan saddex-geesood ah oo nukliyeer ah
item.description: Aqalka Cad ee Mareykanka ayaa Jimcihii shaaciyay in Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu toddobaadka soo socda magaalada Shenzhen ee Shiinaha kula kulmi doono hoggaamiyaha Shiinaha Xi Jinping iyo Madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin, kulankii ugu horreeyay ee saddex-geesood ah ee hoggaamiyeyaasha saddexda dal, sida ay werisay CNN.

item.title: Goolhayaha Andorra Jesús Owono oo 12 kulan laga ganaaxay isku dhacii ku dambeeyay geerida Jesús de Miguel
item.description: Guddiga anshaxa ee Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Isbaanya (RFEF) ayaa Jimcihii 12 kulan ka ganaaxay goolhayaha FC Andorra Jesús Owono, kadib isku dhac uu la galay weeraryahankii Tenerife Jesús de Miguel, kaas oo maalin kadib geeriyooday, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Midowga Yurub iyo shan dal oo diblomaasiyiin u diraya wareegga xiga ee wada-hadallada Ukraine
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Yurub António Costa ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in Yurub ay wareegga xiga ee wada-hadallada nabadda Ukraine u diri doonto koox diblomaasiyiin ah oo ka socda Midowga Yurub iyo shan dal: Ingiriiska, Faransiiska, Jarmalka, Talyaaniga iyo Booland, sida ay werisay France 24.

item.title: Mareykanka oo dalka oo dhan ka joojiyay duulimaadyada, kadib cillad isgaarsiineed oo saameysay xakamaynta hawada
item.description: Hay'adda Duulista Federaalka Mareykanka (FAA) ayaa Jimcihii, 13 November, amar ku bixisay in diyaarad kasta oo ka duulaysa garoomada dalka oo dhan la hakiyo, kadib cillad isgaarsiineed oo saameysay xarumaha gobollada ee xakameeya duulimaadyada, sida ay werisay CNN.

item.title: Soomaaliya oo shirka Golaha Fulinta Midowga Afrika ee Accra ku taageertay in ururku dhaqaale ahaan isku filnaado
item.description: Wasiiru Dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cali Maxamed Cumar (Cali Balcad), ayaa 13 November magaalada Accra ee Ghana ka sheegay in Soomaaliya ay taageersan tahay in Midowga Afrika uu yeesho hannaan dhaqaale oo isku filan, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.

item.title: Microsoft oo raalli-gelin ka bixisay cilladdii adeegyadeeda oo ku dhowaad 24 saacadood carqaladeysay dunida
item.description: Shirkadda Microsoft ayaa sheegtay inay aad uga xun tahay cilladda ku timid adeegyadeeda, oo ay ku jiraan Outlook iyo Teams, kadib markii ay ku dhowaad 24 saacadood carqaladeysay isticmaaleyaasha in ka badan 70 dal, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: Qaraxyo laga maqlay dekedda Jask ee Iran kadib sheegashada IRGC ee weerarka radar Mareykan oo Bahrain ku yaal
item.description: Qaraxyo ayaa Jimcihii 13 November laga maqlay magaalada dekedda ah ee Jask ee koonfurta Iran, sida ay sheegtay wakaaladda wararka dowladda Iran ee IRNA, saacado kadib markii Ilaalada Kacaanka (IRGC) ay sheegatay inay burburiyeen nidaam radar oo Mareykan ah oo ku yaal Bahrain.

item.title: Xeer-ilaalinta Paraguay oo eedeyn cusub u jeedisay madaxweynihii hore Santiago Peña oo la xiriirta burburka bangiga Ueno
item.description: Xafiiska xeer-ilaalinta Paraguay ayaa Jimcihii 13 November madaxweynihii hore Santiago Peña ku eedeeyay ka qaybgal koox dambiyeed, oo la xiriirta doorkiisa la sheegay ee burburka bangiga dijitaalka ah ee Ueno, toddobaad kadib markii baarlamaanku xilka ka qaaday, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Kagame oo booqasho taariikhi ah ku tagay Cambodia, 3 heshiis oo iskaashi ahna la saxiixay
item.description: Madaxweynaha Rwanda Paul Kagame ayaa 13 November magaalada Phnom Penh kula kulmay Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Cambodia Hun Manet, waxaana labada dal kala saxiixdeen 3 heshiis oo ku saabsan maalgashiga, dalxiiska iyo duulimaadyada, sida ay werisay KT Press.

item.title: Ronaldinho oo 46 jir ah oo la filayo inuu Axadda u saftay Ravenna, kulankiisii ugu horreeyay tan iyo 2015
item.description: Xiddiga reer Brazil Ronaldinho ayaa la filayaa inuu Axadda ka bilaabo kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee rasmi ah muddo ka badan 10 sano, marka kooxdiisa Ravenna ay la ciyaarto deriskeeda Forlì horyaalka Serie C ee Talyaaniga, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Ruushka oo wafdi ganacsi oo 70 qof ah u diray Kabul si uu ula xaajooto dowladda Taliban
item.description: Ra'iisul wasaare ku-xigeenka Ruushka Alexei Overchuk ayaa hoggaaminayay wafdi ka kooban 70 ganacsade oo gaaray Kabul, halkaas oo ay dowladda Taliban kala hadleen gaadiidka, beeraha iyo daawooyinka, sida ay werisay Euronews.

item.title: Ruto oo ballan qaaday in waddada Nairobi-Mombasa laga dhigo laba jid muddo sannad gudihiis ah
item.description: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa Jimcihii magaalada Mombasa ka sheegay in dowladdiisu muddo sannad gudihiis ah laba jid ka dhigi doonto waddada weyn ee isku xirta Nairobi iyo Mombasa, sida ay werisay Capital FM Kenya.

item.title: Maxkamadda ICC oo baaritaankeeda Afgaanistaan ku koobtay dambiyada lagu eedeeyay Taliban
item.description: Garsoorayaasha Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah (ICC) ayaa xiray qaybta baaritaanka Afgaanistaan ee lagu eegi karay ciidamada Mareykanka, waxayna baaritaanka ku koobeen dambiyada lagu eedeeyay Taliban, sida ay muujinayaan dukumentiyo maxkamadda oo Jimcihii la shaaciyay.

item.title: Goolhayaha caanka ah ee Mareykanka Alyssa Naeher oo ka fariisatay kubadda cagta xirfadda
item.description: Alyssa Naeher, oo ka mid ah goolhayeyaasha ugu guulaha badan taariikhda xulka haweenka Mareykanka, ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay ka fariisanayso kubadda cagta xirfadda kadib 11 xilli ciyaareed oo ay u ciyaartay kooxda Chicago Stars, sida ay werisay CBS Sports.

item.title: Israa'iil oo la sheegay inay Somaliland u xaqiijisay in aqoonsigu sii jiri doono xitaa haddii xukuumaddeedu isbeddesho
item.description: Mas'uuliyiin Israa'iili ah ayaa hoggaanka Somaliland u xaqiijiyay in Israa'iil aysan ka noqon doonin aqoonsiga ay siisay Somaliland, xataa haddii xukuumadda Tel Aviv ay isbeddesho, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online oo soo xigatay telefishanka dowladda Israa'iil ee KAN.

item.title: OCHA oo ka digtay daacuun iyo shuban-biyood ku faafaya Mudug kadib fatahaadaha
item.description: Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee isku-dubaridka arrimaha bini'aadantinimada (OCHA) ayaa ka digay korodhka cudurrada faafa ee ka dhashay fatahaadihii dhowaan ka dhacay gobolka Mudug, gaar ahaan deegaannada bariga Gaalkacyo, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Turkiga iyo Qatar oo saxiixay heshiis difaac wadaag ah oo Istanbul lagu gaaray
item.description: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan iyo Amiirka Qatar Sheekh Tamiim bin Xamad Aal Thaani ayaa Jimcihii Istanbul ku saxiixay heshiis difaac wadaag ah, xilli ay qabteen shirka 12aad ee Guddiga Istiraatiijiyadeed ee Sare ee labada dal, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: McIlroy iyo Hatton oo wadaaga hoggaanka DP World Tour Championship ee Dubai
item.description: Rory McIlroy iyo Tyrrell Hatton ayaa wadaaga hoggaanka tartanka golf-ka ee DP World Tour Championship ee Dubai kadib labadii maalmood ee hore, iyagoo labaduba ku jira shan dhibcood ka hooseeya par-ka, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Lix qof oo ku dhimatay dhismo siddeed dabaq ah oo ku burburay Syokimau, duleedka Nairobi
item.description: Ugu yaraan lix qof ayaa ku dhimatay kadib markii dhismo siddeed dabaq ah oo aan la dhammaystirin uu subaxnimadii Jimcaha ku burburay Syokimau oo ku taal duleedka Nairobi, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Madaxweyne Ramaphosa oo warqadaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay Safiirka cusub ee Soomaaliya, Aadam Isxaaq
item.description: Madaxweynaha Koonfur Afrika, Cyril Ramaphosa, ayaa maanta Madaxtooyada Pretoria si rasmi ah uga guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga danjirenimo Safiirka cusub ee Soomaaliya u fadhiya Koonfur Afrika, Amb. Aadam Isxaaq.

item.title: Puntland oo ciidamo geysay deegaanka Roox ee Mudug kadib xiisad dhimasho sababtay
item.description: Dowladda Puntland ayaa ciidamo nabadgelyo geysay deegaanka Roox ee gobolka Mudug, halkaas oo maalmo ka hor ay ka dhacday xiisad sababtay dhimashada hal qof, sida ay werisay Puntland Post.

item.title: IAEA oo Iran ugu baaqday inay kormeerayaasha u ogolaato goobaha nukliyeerka ee muhiimka ah
item.description: Hay'adda Tamarta Atomiga ee Caalamka (IAEA) ayaa warbixin cusub ku sheegtay in si degdeg ah loo baahan yahay in dib loo bilaabo kormeerka Iran, maadaama aysan haysan macluumaad ku saabsan uraaniyamka aadka loo kobciyay, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today oo soo xigatay AFP iyo Reuters.

item.title: Weerar diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah ee Ukraine oo Volgograd ku dilay 4 qof
item.description: Afar qof ayaa la dilay, labana waa la dhaawacay, kadib weerar diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah oo Ukraine ku qaaday aag warshadeed oo ku yaal magaalada Volgograd ee koonfurta Ruushka, sida uu sheegay guddoomiyaha gobolka Andrei Bocharov.

item.title: Maxkamadda Sare ee Norway oo go'aamisay in oggolaanshaha saddex goob oo saliid ah uu sharci-darro ahaa
item.description: Maxkamadda Sare ee Norway ayaa 13-kii November go'aamisay in oggolaanshihii dowladdu siisay saddex goob oo saliid iyo gaas ah oo ku yaal Badda Waqooyi uu ahaa mid aan ansax ahayn, maadaama aan la qiimeyn saameynta cimilada, sida ay werisay Sweden Herald.

item.title: Ciidamada IRGC oo sheegay in markab gaas dareere ah uu ku qarxay miino bariga Marinka Hormuz
item.description: Ciidamada badda ee Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran (IRGC) ayaa Jimcaha sheegay in markab sida gaaska dabiiciga ah ee dareeraha (LNG) uu si xoog leh u qarxay kaddib markii uu ku dhacay miino badeed bariga Marinka Hormuz, sheegashadaas oo aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin.

item.title: Zelensky: Ukraine iyo Ruushka waxay ku heshiiyeen isweydaarsigii maxaabiista dagaal ee ugu weynaa
item.description: Madaxweynaha Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelensky, ayaa 12-kii November magaalada Dublin ka sheegay in Ukraine iyo Ruushka ay isku raaceen isweydaarsiga maxaabiista dagaal ee ugu weyn ilaa hadda, kaddib kulan uu la yeeshay ergayada Mareykanka Steve Witkoff iyo Jared Kushner, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Kosovo oo Soomaaliya ka codsatay inay ka caawiso helitaanka sagaal xubnood oo wafdi Soomaaliyeed ka maqan
item.description: Dowladda Kosovo ayaa warqad diblomaasiyadeed ku weydiisatay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya inay ka caawiso ogaanshaha halka ay ku sugan yihiin sagaal xubnood oo ka tirsanaa wafdi Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo 27-kii October ka baxay hoygoodii magaalada Prishtina iyaga oo aan cidna ogeysiin, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Sacuudiga oo Soomaaliya u qoondeeyay 11,500 kursi oo Xajka 2027 ah
item.description: Dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa Soomaaliya u qoondeysay 11,500 boos oo Xaj ah oo loogu talagalay xujeyda Soomaaliyeed ee Xajka 2027, kadib heshiis ay labada dowladood ku kala saxiixdeen magaalada Jeddah, sida ay maanta subax werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Jubaland oo diiday magacaabista hoggaanka Hay'adda Dakhliga Qaranka ee Golaha Wasiirrada
item.description: Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha ee Jubaland ayaa sheegtay inaysan aqoonsanayn magacaabista hoggaanka Hay'adda Dakhliga Qaranka, iyadoo ku doodday in hannaanka dhismaha hay'adda aan lala tashan dowlad-goboleedyada, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Midowga Yurub oo Soomaaliya u qoondeeyay 6 milyan oo Yuuro oo looga hortagayo saameynta El Niño
item.description: Midowga Yurub ayaa Soomaaliya u qoondeeyay 6 milyan oo Yuuro oo lagu xoojinayo u diyaargarowga musiibooyinka iyo taageerada bulshada nugul, xilli laga cabsi qabo in El Niño uu saameyn xooggan ku yeesho qaybo ka mid ah Afrika 2026 iyo 2027, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
